### problem_chain
Root (customer's ask): "whatever is still owed on it, you want to pay it off today so the account is closed out" → P6
(owner=user, `pay_closing_balance_b53536cf`). P6's rule: "When a cancelled HomeFlood policy still shows an amount owed …" and
"The closing payment is fixed only after the account carries the CANCELLATION credit for the signed cancellation request on
file." At frozen_time policy `d501d6eb…` is active and no CANCELLATION credit exists in `homeflood_billing` → unmet. The rule
that books it is P5 ("books the return of premium as one CANCELLATION credit of the TERM_PREMIUM item referenced to the
request") → P5 (`prerequisite: []`; signed request on file, status active → act now).
Derived tree: P6 (root, user) ← P5 (value_input, acct_balance). n = 1, value_input edges 1 ≥ max(0,1). Order P5 → P6.
Isomorphic to the declared field.
Load-bearing: skip P5 → the policy is not cancelled (P6's trigger fails) and the balance stays 617.13 (closing figure on the
opening world 583.35, no prompt credit) instead of 290.84. Bears weight.
No parallel edges. Tools judge nothing (`_difficulty.md` §action_binding_and_uuids). Customer's own write: P6. Persona raises
only the root; the request/settlement statement, the new NFIP policy and the June claim are given only when asked, and the
"processed or booked before" line is an if-reaction.

### task_independent_derivation
Customer `4f489811…` Malcolm Okafor; identity by phone 3055532716 + SSN last4 3492 (ZIP 34105 matches the profile too).
Policy `d501d6eb…` HF-3195820, HomeFlood Plus, AE, building 400,000, effective 2019-12-05, term 2025-12-05 → 2026-12-05
(365 d), QUARTERLY, balance 617.13 (= 3055.68 + 35 + 3×6 − 1257.27 − 2×617.14). Not mortgage-required → no lender release needed.

**P5 cancellation (agent, `process_cancellation_request_bf9010ee`)**, request `35292026…`: PROPERTY_SOLD, effective 2026-09-29,
SETTLEMENT_STATEMENT.
- Term net = TERM_PREMIUM 3055.68 (no endorsement items/credits, no RERATE). LOU part = loss_of_use_premium (Plus) 95.
- Earning basis: effective date after term start; PROPERTY_SOLD with settlement statement → pro rata 67/365.
- LOU return: claim 3HF2602214, loss 2026-06-21 (< 12 months before 2026-10-06) paid LOSS_OF_USE 1200 → nothing.
- Paid-claim share: net paid 3850 + 1200 = 5050 > 0 and < 25 % × 400,000 → 50 %.
- Policy-fee return: 298 days after term start (not < 30); 2 whole months left (2026-09-29 → 2026-12-05) ≥ 2 → 50 % × 35 = 17.50.
- Exit fee: 81 whole months in force (2019-12-05 → 2026-09-29) ≥ 60 → 0.
- Reading A (compute's order: share on the premium parts, then fee return and exit fee):
  (3055.68 − 95) × 67/365 × 50 % + 95 × 67/365 × 0 + 17.50 − 0 = **289.23**.
- Reading B (F1: the paid-claim share is a share "of the cancellation credit", "the whole credit" in its full tier, and the policy-
  fee return is itself "of the cancellation credit"): (543.4536 + 0 + 17.50 − 0) × 50 % = **280.48**. The rule's assembly
  sentence ("Every share and percent this rule states applies to the part of the return it names") does not exclude B; it names
  the cancellation credit as the share's part.
- Write: status cancelled, reason PROPERTY_SOLD, effective 2026-09-29, closed 2026-10-06, credit referenced to the request.

**P6 closing payment (user)**, after P5.
- Account balance 617.13 − 289.23 = 327.90 (reading B: 336.65).
- Overdue installment: latest fee booked is installment 4 (posted 2026-09-05), no payment with number 4 → overdue 31 days on
  2026-10-06 > 30 → late charge 2 % × (20 % × 3055.68) = 12.22272.
- Fee waiver: PROPERTY_SOLD + settlement statement; installment 4 fell due 24 days before the effective date (≤ 30) → 6.00.
- Prompt settlement: policy closed 2026-10-06 (processing date) → 0 days ≤ 7 → 1 % of the balance = 3.279 (also 7 days if
  "closed" were read as the effective date 2026-09-29 — same tier).
- New-home courtesy: NFIP Dwelling `3b8009fa…` at 318 Moorings Park Dr (different address), in force, original effective
  2026-09-29 → 0 days from the request's effective date ≤ 60 → 25.
- Payment record: no NONPAYMENT notice ever on the policy; in force 82 whole months on 2026-10-06 ≥ 60 → 15.
- amount = max(0, round(327.90 + 12.22272 − 6 − 3.279 − 25 − 15, 2)) = **290.84** (reading B: 299.51), ACH.
Terminal: policy cancelled, closed 2026-10-06; CANCELLATION credit 289.23; closing payment 290.84 ACH; balance set to 0.0 by the tool.

## findings
- **T1-P1 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (demonstration of charter F1, P5 paid-claim share scope).** Symptom: P5's rule makes the paid-claim
  share a share "of the cancellation credit" ("… claim_light_share percent when they total more than zero but less than that, and
  the whole credit when they total zero") and its assembly sentence applies each share "to the part of the return it names";
  "The policy-fee return of the cancellation credit" is one of the credit's named parts. `compute.result` applies `claim_pct`
  only to the two premium parts and adds `fee_return` after it. Evidence on this world: claim_pct 50 (net 5050 for the 2026-06-21
  loss), fee_return 17.50, exit fee 0. Reading A (compute, GT): 271.7268 + 17.50 = **289.23** → closing **290.84**. Reading B
  (share on the whole credit): (543.4536 + 17.50) × 50 % = **280.48** → balance 336.65 → closing 336.65 + 12.22272 − 6 − 3.3665 −
  25 − 15 = **299.51**. Both scored values move. Affected: P5 rule (paid-claim share sentence, assembly sentence), `compute.result`;
  this task's steps 9 and 11.
- **T1-T1 — SOURCE-TASK RED (seed row not producible by the base charter; proof text asserts it is; no scored value moves).**
  `homeflood_claims.bad5f32b…` (claim_paid DWELLING 3850.00, claim 3HF2602214) with the FINAL report `80f1e1fa…` (RCV 6350, ACV
  5900) on HomeFlood Plus, dwelling limit 400,000, RCV 520,000: base `homeflood_claim_settlement` pays at RCV only when the
  dwelling limit is at least rc_insurance_to_value_pct (80 %) of the RCV — 400,000 < 416,000 → ACV 5900 − deductible 2500 =
  3400.00. 3850 = RCV − deductible. `solvability_contract.seed_consistency` asserts these claim rows are "consistent with … the
  charter amounts". claim_net would be 4600 instead of 5050 — still the light tier, so no value moves.
- Observations: the closing payment's trigger sentence "When a cancelled HomeFlood policy still shows an amount owed" is a second
  wording of the P6←P5 dependency (same write; `_difficulty.md` §prerequisite_sentences). The prompt-settlement tier is the same
  under "closed" = processing date (0 days) or = effective date (7 days) — no second value. First-match O1 (P6 `nh_eff`
  unfiltered) has one dwelling row here — no value moves.
- Relation to previous revisions: first audit of this task.
